extension.summary: Share Stream Cinema preferences and viewing history through private Kra storage.
extension.description: Synchronize watched states, resume positions, Last seen, selected addon preferences and Amber appearance. Keep credentials, hardware settings and navigation local. Network operations run in the background.
extension.news: 0.1.1: Install and update through the Kodi repository. Reduce background checks while synchronizing promptly after Stop and wake. Restore existing cloud preferences on new devices.
